text:
Maya: quick sync — trying to nail eviction semantics for Dedicated GPU pools. idea: two SLA bands (interactive vs throughput) + soft eviction hints from runtime to operator. thoughts?
Sam: where does enforcement live? runtime admission vs operator node eviction?
Maya: runtime handles per-request admission/priority; operator does node reclamation. main gap: how runtime conveys tenant urgency so operator can make cost-aware evictions.
Alex: prefer soft-scoring rather than hard quotas. lets operator trade fairness vs cost.
Nisha: agree. also prefer graceful downgrade (route to cheaper model variant) instead of immediate reject. eviction should trigger fallback routing when available.
Sam: keep the API compact: eviction_hint with fields: priority (int), reason (enum), lease_id. operator uses these + node telemetry.
Maya: proto sketch: priority 0-100, reason in {PREWARM, HEADROOM_PRESSURE, OVERSUBSCRIBE, QUOTA_EXHAUST}, optional score_components for telemetry.
Maya: example payload:
```
eviction_hint:
  priority: 20
  reason: HEADROOM_PRESSURE
  tenant: tenant-foo
  lease_id: lease-1234
  score_components:
    warmups: 5
    sla_misses: 1
```
ops-bot: note — current scheduler ignores score_components; only uses priority + lease age.
Alex: operator algo idea: victim_score = base - weighted(sum(score_components)) + node_affinity_penalty. evict lowest victim_score first but never drop tenant below reserved_committed_capacity.
Nisha: metrics to add: eviction_reason, preempted_tenants, fallback_routed_count, avg_eviction_latency. gate rollout behind feature flag and add per-tenant eviction history in console.
Sam: rollout plan: (1) internal POC where operator reads hints but doesn't evict, (2) opt-in customers, (3) global opt-in with telemetry + rollback window.
Maya: open Q: surface burst-credit accounting in hint? runtime knows token consumption; operator doesn't. include burst_credit_estimate?
Alex: include normalized burst_score (0-1) in score_components; operator treats it as bias, not hard rule.
Nisha: also confirm: model-variant fallback availability. we should add has_fallback boolean in hint and require model-routing contract; operator should skip eviction if no fallback.
Sam: i'll draft a short RFC fragment with proto + operator pseudocode. will follow with PRs.
Maya: thanks all — ping when RFC + drafts are ready. :+1:
